interface.name: estop
interface.description:
Emergency Stop Signal
FALSE: Emergency stop triggered
TRUE: No emergency stop triggered

interface.name: opeMode
interface.description:
Operation Mode
FALSE: Manual Operation Mode
TRUE: Automatic Operation Mode

scan_semantics: Inputs I[k] are sampled at invocation; outputs O[k] are observed after the call. Retained pre-state q[k] becomes q[k+1]. Each test resets the instance. A transition affects the same observed scan. dt_ms is elapsed time since the preceding invocation; the first invocation starts IEC timers at elapsed zero. CycleTime inputs, where supplied, are attributed to the current invocation rather than inferred from dt_ms.
safety_priority: estop=FALSE turns every actuator off immediately.
Automatic phases drive only one actuator; independent manual toggles may coexist.
assumptions: All manual buttons use rising-edge independent toggles. Edge history updates during emergency stop so held buttons cannot restart outputs on recovery.
Emergency stop resets all manual latches and automatic state. A fresh autoStart edge is required to restart.
Changing operation mode clears old latches and sequence.
autoStart is a rising edge accepted in IDLE; processMode stays fixed during the batch.
Thresholds are >=50, >=80 and >=100 cm. One logical phase transition occurs per invocation.
Valve D stays open after discharge is initiated until emergency stop or mode reset; no drain-complete signal is supplied.

formal_properties.name: Emergency
formal_properties.explanation: Emergency permissive dominates mode and buttons.

formal_properties.name: Manual toggle
formal_properties.explanation: A held button cannot repeatedly toggle; applies independently to all five buttons.

formal_properties.name: First fill threshold
formal_properties.explanation: A closes and B opens at or above 50cm.

formal_properties.name: Mix completion
formal_properties.explanation: Mix completion stops mixing and opens D.

atomic_propositions.toggle: safe AND NOT opeMode AND rising(valveAStart)
atomic_propositions.held: safe AND NOT opeMode AND NOT rising(valveAStart) AND no mode change
atomic_propositions.toB: safe AND opeMode AND pre-phase FILL_A AND levelSensor>=50
atomic_propositions.toMix: safe AND opeMode AND pre-phase FILL_B AND levelSensor>=80 AND NOT processMode
atomic_propositions.toC: safe AND opeMode AND pre-phase FILL_B AND levelSensor>=80 AND processMode
atomic_propositions.fromC: safe AND opeMode AND pre-phase FILL_C AND levelSensor>=100
atomic_propositions.mixed: safe AND opeMode AND pre-phase MIX AND mixMotorComplete
